The '''Mirnic system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the [[Mirnic University]].<ref name="CbaothDatabank">{{DB|character|joruuscbaoth|C'baoth, Joruus}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mirnic system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-18.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
